story_title: South Texas, an hour and a half away
story: McAllen sits in the Rio Grande Valley, where citrus groves and palm trees line the roads and Spanish is heard as often as English. For families from Monterrey, Mexico City and beyond, it has long been the familiar first stop in Texas: a weekend of shopping, a medical consultation, a closing with a bank or a broker. The city is compact and easy, with wide streets, good steakhouses and winter afternoons warm enough to eat outside.

Flying private shrinks the trip to almost nothing. A private jet to McAllen covers about 900 km in an hour and a half, which makes a same-day round trip practical for an appointment at a hospital in Edinburg or a meeting with a cross-border logistics partner. You land, clear US Customs at the airport with only your own group around you, and reach La Plaza Mall or your doctor's office within minutes.
why_title: Why take a private jet to McAllen

why.d: At about 1 hour 30 minutes, McAllen is the closest United States destination on the JETCAB route map from Toluca. Breakfast in Mexico City and a late morning in Texas is a normal schedule, and flying home for dinner is just as easy.

The Rio Grande Valley has major hospitals, including Doctors Hospital at Renaissance in Edinburg and the South Texas Health System. A private cabin lets a patient travel reclined, with family alongside, and return home on their own timetable instead of an airline's.

JETCAB files the eAPIS manifest with US Customs about 24 hours ahead and coordinates your arrival at McAllen. On landing, officers clear your group at the airport without the crowds of a commercial arrival hall, and your car is a few steps away.

From $8,000 USD one way covers the full aircraft with crew, fuel, catering and permits. A family shopping trip, a patient with relatives, or four partners heading to a closing all share the same cabin and the same price, quoted in 30 minutes.

journey_title: Your day from Mexico City to McAllen

journey.d: Your driver picks you up early for the 45 to 60 minute drive west to Toluca. If you would rather skip the highway, the JETCAB helicopter transfer from Polanco, Lomas, Santa Fe or Reforma takes about 25 minutes.

Car to aircraft steps in under 10 minutes at the private terminal. Your passport and visa details went into the eAPIS manifest the day before, so there is nothing to fill out here. Bags go into the hold and you take your seat.

The flight heads north toward the Texas border. Ninety minutes is enough for breakfast and a call, or simply for watching the Sierra Madre Oriental give way to the flat ranchland and farm fields of Tamaulipas below.

You land at McAllen International about 1 hour 30 minutes after takeoff. In winter the clock matches Mexico City, and in summer Texas is one hour ahead. US Customs clears your party at the airport, and your car is waiting.

La Plaza Mall is about five minutes from the airport and downtown McAllen about ten. Start with your appointment or meeting, then have lunch at a steakhouse before an afternoon of shopping or the short drive to Edinburg.

places_title: What to do in McAllen after you land

places.name: La Plaza Mall
places.d: McAllen's best-known shopping center has drawn Mexican families for decades, with department stores such as Macy's and Dillard's and a long list of brands under one roof. It sits a few minutes from the airport, which makes a half-day shopping run before the flight home entirely realistic.

places.name: Quinta Mazatlán
places.d: A 1930s adobe mansion set in more than 15 acres of native thorn forest, now one of the World Birding Center sites. Walk the shaded trails early for green jays, great kiskadees and plain chachalacas, then tour the house and its Spanish Revival details.

places.name: South Padre Island
places.d: About an hour and a half by car, the island has some of the clearest water on the Texas coast, long pale beaches and seafood on the bay side at sunset. Summer brings families and fishing charters, while winter offers quiet sand and dolphin tours from Port Isabel.

places.name: Santa Ana National Wildlife Refuge
places.d: On the Rio Grande about 20 minutes from the city, this refuge protects a rare stretch of native subtropical forest. Hundreds of bird species pass through, and in autumn the trails fill with butterflies. It makes a peaceful morning between meetings or appointments.

best_time: McAllen is subtropical. From June to September afternoons regularly pass 100°F, so plan outdoor time for the mornings. October through April is the comfortable season, with winter highs in the 70s, when Winter Texans arrive from the Midwest and birders come for migrating species. The McAllen Holiday Parade in early December is one of the largest in Texas, and the Christmas shopping season keeps hotels busy. Spring break fills South Padre Island. US flights need about 24 hours for the eAPIS manifest, so book a day ahead whenever you can.
airport: McAllen International Airport, long known as McAllen Miller International, sits about two miles south of downtown. docs_title: Documents for a private jet to McAllen
docs: Mexican citizens need a valid passport and a valid US visa. US citizens travel on their passport, and permanent residents on their green card. JETCAB files the eAPIS manifest with US Customs, so send each passenger's full name, date of birth and passport number about 24 hours before departure. Children need their own documents. For medical trips, carry any records or test results your doctor asked for in your hand luggage.

faq.a: Yes. At about 1 hour 30 minutes each way, a same-day round trip is easy to plan around a medical appointment, a closing or a day of shopping. Tell us your return time when you request the quote and JETCAB prices both legs together.

An empty leg is a flight an aircraft makes without passengers, usually to reposition after dropping someone off. When one happens to match your route and date, it can be offered at a lower price. The timing is set by the original trip, so it suits travelers with flexible plans.
